summary: Synchronously invoke the emit-start listener snapshot in registration order and return whether listeners existed.

target.notes: Must synchronously call listeners in registration order, bind ordinary-function this to the emitter through existing FUNCTIONS semantics, ignore listener return values, propagate thrown exceptions, and snapshot listeners at emit start.

semantics.listener_throw: propagates immediately; later listeners are not called
semantics.mutation_during_emit: current listener snapshot remains in effect

caveats: Do not schedule listeners through Task/async dispatch; that changes ordering and exception propagation.
The 'error' event has additional no-listener semantics covered by node.events.event-emitter.emit-error-unhandled.

tests.name: ordered synchronous dispatch and boolean result
tests.input: const {EventEmitter}=require('node:events'); const e=new EventEmitter(); const out=[]; e.on('x',()=>out.push(1)); e.on('x',()=>out.push(2)); console.log(e.emit('x'),out.join(','),e.emit('none'));

tests.name: throw stops later listener
tests.input: const {EventEmitter}=require('node:events'); const e=new EventEmitter(); const out=[]; e.on('x',()=>{out.push('a');throw Error('boom')}); e.on('x',()=>out.push('b')); try{e.emit('x')}catch(err){out.push(err.message)} console.log(out.join(','));
